edges.reason: msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from argument via _msgSender().
msg.sender is the caller/spender in transferFrom allowance updates.
block.timestamp is compared against cooldown[to] to gate transfers.
block.timestamp is used to compute the new cooldown expiry.
Timestamp arithmetic result is stored into the cooldown mapping.
from parameter controls the transfer source inside _transfer.
to parameter controls the transfer destination inside _transfer.
amount parameter controls the transferred value inside _transfer.
tokenAmount parameter is passed to the router swap call.
bots_ array is iterated and written to the bots mapping.
notbot address is written into the bots mapping.
contractTokenBalance is passed as tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is passed as the amount to sendETHToFee.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call mid-transfer.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee, moving ETH out during the transfer flow.
_transfer delegates the accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee application.
_transfer requires !bots[from] && !bots[to] using the bots mapping.
_transfer reads cooldownEnabled to activate cooldown checks.
_transfer reads inSwap before attempting the swap-for-ETH block.
_transfer reads swapEnabled to gate the automatic swap.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount during cooldown.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap call.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router address.
lockTheSwap sets inSwap true before and false after the swap.
sendETHToFee performs the raw ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the recipient of half the ETH in sendETHToFee.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the recipient of half the ETH in sendETHToFee.
openTrading assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair address.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading sets the initial _maxTxAmount.
openTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
openTrading sets cooldownEnabled to true.
openTrading uses owner() as the liquidity recipient.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
blacklistBots writes true into the bots mapping.
delBot writes false into the bots mapping.
removeStrictTxLimit resets _maxTxAmount to full supply.
setCooldownEnabled updates the cooldownEnabled flag.
transfer calls _transfer with msg.sender as source.
transferFrom calls _transfer before updating allowances.
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth which performs an external swap.
manualswap requires the caller to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee which transfers ETH externally.
manualsend requires the caller to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
_tokenTransfer updates _rOwned balances through _transferStandard.
_tokenTransfer relies on _getValues for amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current rate.
_getRate reads _rTotal as the reflection supply.
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply without an explicit zero-check.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for supply values.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal and _tTotal for supply comparison.
External router swap may re-enter token transfer logic before state settles.
ETH transfer to fee wallets may re-enter _transfer via the receive() fallback.
_transfer compares from/to against owner() to bypass fee logic.

normalization_plan.reason: from is only used as the transfer source argument inside _transfer and carries no independent state.
to is a transient destination argument of _transfer used for blacklist, cooldown and pair checks.
amount only parameterizes the transfer and is immediately transformed into reflection values.
tokenAmount only feeds the router swap call inside swapTokensForEth.
bots_ is consumed solely by the blacklisting loop writing into the bots mapping.
notbot is only used to clear a single entry of the bots mapping.
contractTokenBalance is derived locally and passed straight into swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is derived locally and passed straight into sendETHToFee.
